item.title: Reflection on Unit 2
item.description: In Unit 2, The Nature of Information Problems, we examined how digital images represent information through pixel intensity values. We worked with a grayscale image and visualized its pixel structure to understand how images are composed numerically. A histogram of pixel intensities was plotted to analyze the distribution of brightness levels within the image. We then increased the brightness and generated a new histogram to observe changes in intensity distribution. In the laboratory session, we applied edge detection techniques,including the extraction of horizontal edges and image blurring. Additionally, we performed image rotation at different angles to study geometric transformations and their effects on image representation. We learnt to estimate Video size.

item.title: My First Post
item.description:
This is My 1st Post on my Reflections.

In last few weeks of classes I learned what is DIKW Model and it’s limitations and I learned Markdown. With my Group we tried to write a wiki on the 4th lesson of The Information: A History, a Theory, a Flood by James Gleick. I learned to analyze the Census education data of Bangalore using Google sheets and also I plotted some charts to visualize what I analyzed on census data.
